designationHistory.indexText: Established April 22, 1999, by agreement between the Fish and Wildlife Service and Interior's Office of Insular Affairs; Secretarial Order 3210 later gave the Service administration of the island.

authority.citation: FWS-Office of Insular Affairs memorandum of understanding; Secretarial Order 3210 (Dec. 3, 1999)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
